status: exploratory extension after the primary test results were reported
main_model: frozen selected weighted LightGBM; no new selection or tuning on test

questions.question: Which feature groups add useful prediction information?
questions.design: Fixed LightGBM ablations on the existing proper-fit/calibration patients; score only validation. Compare core, core plus labs/vitals, core plus history, full, and core plus availability patterns.

questions.question: For which drugs are ranking, resistance detection and calibration reliable?
questions.design: Frozen test predictions; drug-level patient-cluster intervals, resistance AP with prevalence baselines, validation-defined reliability bins with sparse flags.

questions.question: What happens when screening aims to find more resistance?
questions.design: Choose 70%, 80%, 90% resistance-recall targets on validation; freeze thresholds, then report test recall, false alerts and missed resistance per 1000 candidate rows. Retain original threshold as reference.

questions.question: Where does incomplete label coverage limit interpretation?
questions.design: Top six organisms by training frequency, fixed candidate order; report retained S/R label coverage among included organism-events. Missing labels never become outcomes.

uncertainty: 95% pointwise patient-cluster percentile intervals, fixed models; no refitting or simultaneous coverage claim
presentation: Consistent drug order, resistance probabilities, restrained colors; PNG figures with axis names and tick labels only
limits: No causal interpretation of feature ablations or availability patterns.
No clinical utility, treatment-benefit or external-site claim.
No calendar trend analysis because dates are shifted per patient.
Validation ablations and post hoc test diagnostics need independent confirmation.
